selection_controls: exactly 8 aligned/whitespace words; duration gap <=0.5 s; six distinct real IDs and nominal synthetic groups per method; max 3 pairs per family; certified maximum sum of relative match scores (minimum sum of percentile ranks)
score_definition: 100*(1-percentile rank within the common controlled pool); higher is closer, not a human quality or identity probability
word_count_caution: Real aligned word count and synthetic whitespace words use existing source definitions; boundary/transcript validation remains pending.
